!Page still under construction! IGN Guide The Ayanad Earring is a multi-stage self upgrading reward from a lengthy questline. Quest 1: Orb Of Secrets To begin kill Recordkeeper Wynn he will drop an item for everyone in your party called Unknown Orb. Click on the orb to begin a quest, Orb of Secrets. Simply talk to Lemian on the Floor 1 Lobby of the Library, Introspect Path. He will lead you to the next quest requirements. Quest 2: Special Collection Lemian will send you to Floor 1 of the Library to look for 3 items. They are located in the rooms below. Part 1 – A6 Part 2 – H6 Part 3 – F4 You will need to go to these rooms and click on the book on the floor that will teleport you up. Look around for the item. It should be glowing or have a line indicator above it. After collecting all 3 parts, talk to Lemian again. Quest 3: Aranzeb’s Student Lemian will then send you to meet Belstrom. He is located north of the Library, on the overlooking hill above the West Purification Node. Quest 4: Orb’s Identity Belstrom will ask you to bring him 30 Ayanad Wizard’s Tokens. Hopefully, you have enough of these on you already from doing library dailies. Simply talk to Belstrom again to get your Rare Lost Ayanad Earring. Quest 5: Bound After talking to Belstrom, go back to Library Floor 1, room A6. Teleport up via the book on the ground and go to the secret door in front of the glowing book. Remember to equip your Lost Ayanad Earring from this point on, while doing the following quests. Quest 6: Stena's Spellbook After talking to Belstrom, go back to Library Floor 1, room H6. Teleport up via the book on the ground and go to the secret door. In this room, there is a giant bookcase called Stena’s Bookshelf. You will need a party to defeat this boss. Talk to Belstrom after you obtain the item. Quest 7: Gildaron's Heart Go back to Library Floor 1, room F4. Teleport up via the book on the ground and go to the secret door. In this room, there is a big dog called Gildaron the Disobedient. You will need a party to defeat this boss. Talk to Belstrom after you obtain the item. Quest 8: Freeing Slevin Go to Slevin in Floor 1, A6. He will ask you to collect 3 Ayanad Senior Council Manaprints from any of the library dungeon bosses; Recordkeeper Wynn, Halnaak or Alexander. After that, talk to Belstrom again for the Arcane Solemn Ayanad Earring. Quest 9: A Speedy Recovery Go to Slevin in Floor 1, A6. He will ask you to collect 3 Ayanad Senior Council Manaprints from any of the library dungeon bosses; Recordkeeper Wynn, Halnaak or Alexander. After obtaining the Ayanad Senior Council Manaprints , return to Slevin. Quest 10: The Ghostly Mage Slevin will send you to Floor 2 of the Library. Talk to Mage Miller’s Spirit in the Inkcalm Chamber (G8). Quest 11: An End to the Bloodshed Mage Miller’s Spirit will ask you to collect the following: Secret Garden Soulstone - Guardian Golem - Floor 2, A7 Secret Study Soulstone - Halnaak’s Secret Study Guard - Floor 2, F1 10 Ayanad Council Manaprints Kaylin the Rimewriter - Floor 1 Stena the Vile - Floor 1 Runert the Titan - Floor 2 Study Page Ecktom - Floor 2 Captain Jergant - Floor 3 Head Librarian Tinnereph - Floor 3 Fifth Stage Chest - Corner Reading Room Quest 12: Disarming the Library Combine the following: Tri-Dimensional Magic Scroll (given to you by NPC when you obtain this quest), a Solemn Ayanad Earring and 30 Ayanad Wizard’s Tokens to make an Anima Cube. After making the Anima Cube, you have to obtain 1500 Anima Fragments. Follow these steps to obtain them. Go to Floor 3 and look for Ayanad Guard Mage or Librarian Mage. Pls refer to this document for specific locations. Target the mage and right click on the Anima Cube. As you are channelling, you will get the Anima Fragments. You get 5 Anima Fragments per channel. The mob will aggro to you after you are done channelling, but you can reset it by running out of the room. The Anima Cube cannot be used in combat. When you are done, return to Mage Miller’s Spirit in the Inkcalm Chamber on the second floor of G8 for your Heroic Gleaming Ayanad Earring. Quest 13: Captive Souls Talk to Belstrom in Diamond Shores to begin this quest. Talk to Gatekeeper Priest Marquad on Ynys Isle. Chat with Gatekeeper Priest Marquad. Quest 14: Nui's Breath Collect Nui’s Breath from Gatekeeper Priest Marquad. Deliver the Nui’s Breath to Belstrom in Diamond Shores. Quest 15: A Potent Spell Belstrom will give you a Magic Conversion Scroll. Combine the following to make a Blessed Spellstone. 60 Ayanad Wizard’s Tokens - Complete Library Dailies 10 Ayanad Owl Rubellites Gildaron the Disobedient - Floor 1, F4 Stena’s Bookshelf - Floor 1, H6 10 Ayanad Owl Topazes Guardian Golem - Floor 2, A7 Halnaak’s Secret Study Guard - Floor 2, F1 10 Ayanad Owl Aquamarines Screaming Archives Secret Study Guard - Floor 3, G6 Tinnereph’s Secret Study Guard - Floor 3, C6 Return to Belstrom in Diamond Shores. Quest 16: Magic and Manaprints Collect the following items: 20 Ayanad Senior Council Manaprint Recordkeeper Wynn Halnaak Alexander 20 Ayanad Council Manaprints Kaylin the Rimewriter - Floor 1 Stena the Vile - Floor 1 Runert the Titan - Floor 2 Study Page Ecktom - Floor 2 Captain Jergant - Floor 3 Head Librarian Tinnereph - Floor 3 Fifth Stage Chest - Corner Reading Room 20 Ayanad Anima Combine 15 Nayah Crystal Shard to get 1 Nayah Crystal. Click on it to get a quest. Complete the quest to get 1 Ayanad Anima. You can do this quest once a day. Return to Belstrom in Diamond Shores. Quest 17: Into the Light Collect Hereafter Lodestone and deliver it to Mage Miller’s Spirit in Floor 2, G8. Then talk to Slevin at Floor 1 A6 for your Unique Brilliant Ayanad Earring. h: How to Make the Basic Glider
x: In Archeage Classic there are many different kind of gliders available. From early levels players get rewarded their first so called basic glider that doesn't have any skills yet. By upgrading it players can use various skills and stay airborne longer. In Archeage term gliding is basically player jumping from a high place or from their standing point with the assist of their glider skill and descending momentarily. Some gliders have skills to pump up the altitude while gliding but the way is always down eventually. Meaning there is no "flying" in the game as in staying in the air as long as the players wants. Taking damage while gliding will drop the player down. There are certain stats on the glider that can be enhanced by upgrading the glider. Those stats consist of: Gliders Flight Speed = Speed of forward movement Gliding Ability = How slowly it loses altitude Turning Speed = How fast and sharp it can turn Launch Height = How far up it launches you Special Skill Magithopters Air Speed = Speed of forward movement Cruising Ability = How slowly it loses altitude Sheering Speed = How fast and sharp it can turn Ascension = How far up it launches you Special Skill Magithopters differentiate from gliders in that Magithopters can hover in place and descend slower than gliders. They also have really close turning radius meaning player will turn while hovering in their place. They are also in general slower but boost player far more higher when standing still and using glider. Magithopters also have more, so called, customizations like wings, backbags or balloons. How to Make the Basic Glider Every player gets a free basic glider from the quests while leveling early on (experimental glider). This basic glider can be upgraded to have more skills and faster gliding speed by buying blueprints from Mirage Island and crafting at the Machining bench. Glider blueprints When you enter Mirage you need to travel on the left side to find the blueprint place. Mirage Island does sell the first glider players get from the early quests too so it is easy to craft another glider. Below basic glider's list in order of upgrading. Basic glider doens't have any special skill. This page is a WIP ArcheAge is a sandbox game, there are a variety of ways to make money. The main way you will make your gold is by using your labor. Choose one that fits your playstyle and the amount of time you want to commit to making gold. As you increase your proficiency in any given profession, your silver per labor spent will increase. If you haven't, it may also be helpful to read the Making Gold section of the Getting Started guide. Land See Owning Land for additional information Land has many different uses to help a player's economy. It can be used to grow materials that can be sold or crafted. It can also be used to stage trade packs for more efficient trade running. Some players even make money from simply claiming and selling land. There are a variety of building designs that can be used to claim land. Generally, they fall into 3 categories: Scarecrows, Houses, and Farmhouses. Professions Larceny Fishing Commerce Farming/Gathering Mining Any crafting profession Note that players will also pay your for your labor. Labor-free Methods Working on a castle (Lord Coins) Selling your Gilda Stars Selling your Honor Points Selling your Prestige Selling your Loyalty Selling your Merit Badges Other Methods Auroria Land (Logs / Waters) Mysterious Chests Abyssal Attack

h: Wardrobe costumes available in the game
x: Costume are a great way to customize the look of your character. In Archeage Classic there are wardrobe costumes that change the whole look of the character and appearance items that change only certain part of the characters appearance. These two can't be mixed together or used at the same time. Costumes are obtainable mainly through Marketplace with credits or rewards from events or achievements. Costumes can be little bit different looking depending of the played race or sex of the character. Some costumes can be dyed to customize the color of the costume. Costume Fusion Costumes slot Usually players have wardrobe costumes in their costume slot. The costume slot is the top one in character profile (default keybind "C"). From the tiny wheel players can choose Character Display settings. From there the helmet can be hidden and Back Slot Display decided what items are shown. Some wardrobe costumes have two different looks meaning players can toggle between Original and Alternate looks. Wardrobe costumes can also be hidden so the player can only see their characters gear. Image Item Image item is a term for costumes that can be put on top of another item through Item Fusion. Usually players fuse Stat Costumes (bought from Guild shop) with the wardrobe costumes in order to get the stat and looks at the same time. All costumes need to be made into Image items by using Fusion Alembics on them once. Once the item is an Image Item it will have the tiny blue cross on the bottom left of the item icon. Without making an item into Image item it can't be used in fusion. In the same way, other gear pieces, weapons etc. can be turned into Image items and be put on top of the gear you wish to actually use. Be careful not to make the items you wants stats from into the appearance item! h: Picking a Castle to work on
x: Work Permit in Prestige Shop In ArcheAge, one of the optional dailies you'll find is working at a castle! On Classic, castles are located on the continent of Auroria in Nuimari, Calmlands, Heedmar, and Marcala. Working in a Castle grants Lord's Coins, which can be very useful for later gear progression. They're also sought after and players will pay a fair price for them Obtaining a Work Permit To obtain a Work Permit, you'll first have to be in a Guild. In the prestige shop, you'll find a Blank Work Permit for 50 Prestige Picking a Castle to work on Picking a castle to work on is dependent on two things: The Ruling Guild The state of the castle You'll usually want to prefer a castle with many farms as it helps get Territoken Quests faster. As for the ruling guild, this is more of a personal preference. Workers on a Castle generate taxes for the Ruling Guild, which in turn generate Lord's Coins for them. You may want to prefer a ruling guild that aligns with what you like in game. But this is entirely a personal choice. Acquiring Lord's Coins Work Orders Work Orders are triggered by the ruling guild of a castle. When a work order is triggered, the workbenches on the castle Fortress will ask players spend some labor in exchange for a Lord's Coin. Ruling Guilds will trigger Work Orders to receive Territory Building Materials, which can be used to build Walls, Farms and all Castle buildings. Territokens Territokens are acquired at the castle's marketplace and gives you a token to trade in to any farm that has a quest to give. there are several quests you can take but the best one by far is given by the settler arborist which yields 50 pence or 1 full lord's coin (depending if you get the territory pack or the saplings) after four hours when you have planted the territory saplings. you can also take a quest that requires you to bring aurorian waters or flaming log bundles or a hunting quest. the territory product as mentioned above can spawn on any of the workers when their cooldown runs out, you will need to deliver to the market if you decide to take it ( this can be stolen by players so be vary).

Usage of Activity Tokens Bench in Mirage Isle where you can exchange your activity tokens for rewards. Activity Tokens can be exchanged for various rewards on mirage isle, including decent starting accessories, regrade scrolls, synthium shards, Gilda Stars, and Warrior Medals. They can also be used in combination with a Priceless Coin to acquire certain gliders and mounts. The desk is located on the left side down the stairs after entering Mirage Island. All of the quests can be obtained from Shadow Daru in each main city capitol. Sources of Activity Tokens Weekly These quests are only able to be picked up on their respective day, but can be completed throughout the week. Weekly (Friday Reset) Crystalline Bloodbath quest gives 30 tokens each week once completed. Weekly (Saturday Reset) Fishing quest gives 20 tokens each week once completed. Weekly (Satuday Reset) Delphinad Ghost Ship to kill the ghost ship at the sea gives 33 tokens each week once completed. Weekly (Satuday Reset) Ayanad Library kill bosses in the Ayanad Library gives 10 token per quest (2 quests). Weekly (Sunday Reset) Anthalon kill quest gives 33 tokens each week once completed. To unlock this quest, you must first complete the custom story quests (Chapter 99) where you must kill the Hounds of Kyrios and then Anthalon. Daily Daily Active Adventurers Appreciated merit quest gives 5 tokens for spending labor on professions. This can be picked up in your list of daily merit quests. One-time Complete story quest 99.1 (Hounds of Kyrios) for 1 token (use this to unlock your merit quest). Complete the participate in the Veroe Harvest Festival achievement for 5 tokens. Complete the "The Harvest Festival Beckons!" quest from an auctioneer for 50 tokens.

There are various helpful and competitive pets to find and level in ArcheAge Classic, Because there is a number of ways to obtain these pets, They are categorized as such below. Pets that are categorized as Starter pets are bought from an intractable box and as such, they do not have a factional affiliation and can be bought and used by any faction. Pets do not share cooldowns and can be rotated under the condition that the pet is not in combat. You can buy as many instances of the same pet as you desire. Once these pets have been obtained they can be placed in any valid farming area, fed a vita root and washed with water, after a short delay turning into full grown pets and being transported to your inventory to spawn as you please. Double Peace Route Double peace refers to a trade run route on the Nuian (west) continent where the peace cycle of the zones Hellswamp and Halcyona line up, allowing for a very long trade route, resulting in a higher value per pack. Generally, players will start in either Ahnimar, Hellswamp, or Halcyona. To take maximum advantage of the peace cycle, it's best to stage your packs somewhere along the route and run it through the non-war zones once the "double peace" is over. You can view the different pack values on the community made Trade Pack Values Spreadsheet

The Daru Relic event is a small event where the player receives one quest starter daily, can complete a quest chain which unlocks the ability to place a cauldron to craft special event items. This event can offer very good rewards with the [Mystic Daru's Lucky Gift]! Daily Quest Chain Mission: A Daru Relic You can obtain the quest starter by clicking the gift here After obtaining the quest starter, you'll have to use the item and then report to an Auctioneer. They can be found next to most Mirage Portals. Helter Smelter The second quest of the chain requires the player to obtain 50 Iron Ore, and then go to a Smelter to craft 5x [Refined Iron Ingot] Quest Description Refine Iron Ingot Recipe Cookware Repair The next step requires the player to repair the cauldron: By fusing the 5 shards obtained in the previous quest, and the 5 refined iron ingots they crafted, players will complete this quest! Quest Desc Recipe With this, you'll have a Daru Cauldron! It only lasts 30 minutes so be ready to complete the rest! Potions Lessons With your Daru Cauldron placed down, you'll have to craft the following potions. You can do 3 of these a day thanks to the Magic Solution you got from the previous quest. Recipe (same for Vocation Elexir) The Mystic Daru Lastly, the player will be asked to make two Mystic Daru Summoning Potions! These can be used to spawn a Daru which gives the player a gift! Other Event Information The Cauldron can be used outside of quests! You can craft more Mystic Daru Summoning Potions if you wish to try your luck and get more gifts By completing all quests, you'll get 3 Potent Catalyst. Questing When doing the [Quest name of quest where you craft obsidian to get wisp] quest on your story quest line, instead of crafting an illustrious from scratch, find a public armorer house to craft an illustrious weapon at (or just buy the wisp off the auction house) If you lose track of your story quest, open your settings and go to Game Info -> Quest Details Map Display and set it to Unlimited. If you're trying to get a Divine+ Ayanad weapon, check out the Reforge, Regrade, & Mana Seal guide. Back to Ships or Galleons Sails in ArcheAge are the sole avenue for propulsion on most boats, (save fishing boats and speedboats) whilst some boats can be equipped with only one type of sail, Galleons, in particular, can be equipped with a variety of sails that have different pros and cons, we will explore these aforementioned sails in this wiki page. Starting with the most widely used sail on the majority of boats, The Caernord Zephyr Triangular Rig. This sail is the only equipable sail on the Adventurer's Clipper, Harpoon Clipper and Merchant Schooner. It does not have any additional tiers and can only be regraded, regrading gives the sail additional health and ship max movement speed. The changes to the sail are listed by tier below. Seabreeze Shroudlight Back to Galleons A Shroudlight is a type of ship lighting, which is an upgrade to the standard ship lighting, the basic Zephyr Lamp. Shroudlights are used to temporarily hide a ship from the compass/radar view of other ships. Whilst it doesn't render the ship invisible, it does remove the ship from any compass and/or radar view for a short time. Each Shroudlight use consumes 15 Eco-friendly Fuel. When a ship has 2 Shroudlights equipped, alternating use of both Shroudlights will double the time the ship is hidden from view of other ships' compasses and radar. There are 4 tiers of Shroudlight available, and they are: Seabreeze Weight 550kg, Duration 60 sec, Cooldown 60 sec Mistral Weight 600kg, Duration 120 sec, Cooldown 120 sec Seastorm Weight 650kg, Duration 180 sec, Cooldown 180 sec Typhoon Weight 700kg, Duration 240 sec, Cooldown 240 sec -page still in progress- tbc

h: Creating an Addon Folder And Installing an Addon
x: Back to Custom Server Changes Addons are a custom change on ArcheAge Classic to allow players to further customize their in-game UI and add other quality of life features previously not found in the original version of ArcheAge. Creating an Addon Folder And Installing an Addon Create a folder titled "addons" in "Documents/AAClassic" Create a file named "addons.txt" in the "addons" folder. Download an addon you'd like to use. Extract the addon's archive into the "addons" folder. Write the name of the addon's folder into "addons.txt" 1. Create the "addons" folder in "Documents/AAClassic" 2. Create a text document named "addons" (underlined in red) 4. Extract your downloaded addon's archive into the "addons" folder (underlined in green) 5. Write the name of the addon's folder into "addons.txt" If done correctly, on the character select screen there will be an "Addons" button that you can press and will show your installed addons. How it works Every 4 hours 28 treasure chests spawn in Auroria. Interacting with these chests will either spawn a monster or give the player a tradepack worth 400g delivered to any ocean trader. The chance of getting the chest is about 1/25. The server broadcasts the tradepack's coordinates when spawned. Chests spawn in a general area, the map markers only roughly represent the area. The spawn timer resets every time the server restarts, and is usually several minutes before the announcement that the server is back up. Interactable treasure chest

Currently editing. (Aug 28, 2024) WIP Static Infobars Upper Left - Character Statistics This is a static info bar located at the upper left side of the in-game window. The top row lists the character level, character name, and active combat skills. If the character has unread mail, an envelope icon will be displayed. The next two rows are the green Health bar and the blue Mana bar, which show the total and current amounts for these attributes. The next row(s) of icons are any effects or conditions (Buffs) that are active. If the character has no active buffs, there is nothing displayed below the mana bar. Moving the mouse cursor over the area displays a window that lists the following: Occupation, Health, Mana, Equipment Points, Leadership, PvP Honor, and Hostile Faction Kills Upper Right - Location Hotbar & Mini Map This static info bar allows the player to view information about his current location (Region). The top row of icons, from left to right are: frame rate (if enabled). map size (S, M, L), markers and map settings. The player can place temporary markers on the Mini Map. If the player is in a Raid or a Party, only the leader can place these markers. The markers are temporary and disappear if the player changes region or logs out. The settings button (cog wheel) allows you to select if the Mini Map is displayed and if icons are displayed on it. These icons are the ones that you select on the Main Map, located in the lower right of the UI. The colored bar shows the time of day as a graphic, if the cursor is moved over the bar, the current Server Time will be displayed. The Region name. and any important status effects regarding the Region are displayed in this area. this displays what faction controls the area (if any), if it is in war or conflict and the time that status is in effect. Lower Left - Divine Clock - Labor - Loyalty & Experience This is a static display of the Divine Clock or AAC Patron Clock. for rewards the can be redeemed for time spent in game. These timers do not progress while the player is logged out. The count down resumes when the player returns to the game. This static info bar shows the current percentage of experience that the player has gained towards the next level, the amount of labor points currently remaining and the amount of Loyalty Tokens the player has in his <<BAG>> (confirm this info) Lower Right - Auction House - Daily Schedule - Marketplace The Auction House is a player driven marketplace for buying and selling of items. The Daily Schedule has the following tabs: Login Tracker, Daily Quests, Details, and Events The Marketplace contains items that are available for purchase with Credits, Loyalty Tokens or Gilda Stars In Game Menu - Lower Right From left to right, the items are as follows: Character, Bag, Quest Log, Achievements, Skills Window, Map, Vocation, Community, Ranking Information, Menu. Each item has a link for more detailed information. Movable Infobars Target This is a static info bar that only appears when the character has selected or targeted an item in world. Some menu items, such as "Follow", are only available from this info bar. It appears in the middle of the upper screen. Chat Window This is a resizable, movable window that displays conversation or game alerts. A more detailed description can be found under the entry about in game chat and messaging. Quest Menu This is a resizable, movable window that displays active quests. Only the quests that the player has selected to be visible will show up here. More detailed information can be found under the entry about the Quest Log. Skills Hotbar(s) Skill hotbar, mount hot bar, fishing hot bar. A more detailed explanation of this area is found on the page about hotkeys and skills. (edit this info)

The Miner Farmhouse is a thatched farmhouse that has been upgraded through the remodel menu. The upgrade adds 2 seed beds to the farmhouse and a mining drill, in addition to changing the look of the farmhouse. Mining Drill The mining drill will either be normal or lucky, and then will proceed through 3 phases. Each phase will take additional time to accumulate and will result in larger drops. Example of Staged Packs Staging is a way players can take advantage of their land to make for more efficient trade running. If you're delivering packs out of a zone with a Peace/War cycle, staging packs on land soon after you exit that zone, rather than completing the full run, more efficiently uses the Peace cycle of the zone. For example, if you are doing the Double Peace Trade Run, you could stage your packs as soon after leaving Halcyona.

Land has many different uses to help a player's economy. It can be used to grow materials that can be sold or crafted. It can also be used to stage trade packs for more efficient trade running. Some players even make money from simply claiming and selling land. Taxes Owning land requires you to pay taxes each week using Tax Certificates, and the amount of taxes you owe scales with the amount of land you own. All the designs There are a variety of building designs that can be used to claim land. Generally, they fall into 3 categories: Scarecrows, Houses, and Farmhouses. Scarecrows serve as an empty plot that you can fill with plants, animals, or other resources. Houses serve as more of a vanity option for land owning. Farmhouses are a mixture of both, but are more costly to build and take up more space. Designs are categorized also by their size that they take when placing. Smallest land piece that can be owned needs a 8x8 plot and biggest being 44x44. Below a list of all available designs, what materials they need to be built and what features each one has. 8x8 16x16 24x24 28x28 44x44 Improving / Remodeling Land There are many designs that can be improved or remodeled fore certain purposes. Scarecrows can be upgraded into pavilions to increase the plot size to 24x24, increasing the farming space and allowing for some room for furniture. Houses can be remodeled to add functionality, such as an improved crafting station or the ability to craft fertilizer packs. Farmhouses can be remodeled to add functionality, such as seed beds or a mining drill that can be harvested.

The Emerald Weapon line is a set of weapons created to help new players by providing them with an easily accessible starter weapon. Once upgraded via synthesis to the maximum quality of divine, it is roughly equivalent to a celestial quality ayanad weapon. Be warned though, whilst upgrading your emerald weapon is entirely safe, it's still quite a lot of work! Fortunately, it requires no gold, and very little labor, so it's an excellent task for new players to work on when they've finished their money making for the day. Obtaining your Emerald Weapon Quest Starter for the Emerald Weapons To obtain your emerald weapon you'll need to grab yourself an Emerald gem, and head to the Tehmi Ruins area of Hasla, either head their yourself, or ask a friendly Daru or player to open a portal to the Abandoned Drill Camp. There you will find Fragment Researcher Soa, who, in return for a normal emerald, will provide you an Infused Emerald, the key component in crafting your emerald weapon. Head over to the special crafting bench behind you, and check out the possibilities. Upgrading your Emerald weapon Emerald weapons make use of the synthesis system in order to improve their grade, this means that rather than risking the items destruction via regrading, you can instead safely progress the weapon knowing that it is safe, making it easy, if time consuming, to level it to the maximum available grade of divine. Synthesis works by "feeding" a source material to the item you would like to upgrade, in the case of Emerald weapons, that source material is the line of weapons normally referred to as "Hasla weapons" by killing the nearby monsters you are able to collect tokens, these tokens are used to craft, and upgrade, Hasla weapons. Any combination of T1, 2 or 3 weapons can be used to progress the synthesis of your Emerald Weapon, with approximately 22400 xp total being required to reach the Divine grade. There is no benefit for progressing synthesis beyond the Divine grade. Weapon Tier Tokens Required Cumalative Tokens Synthesis XP XP/Token T1 150 150 800 5.33 T2 200 350 1800 5.14 T3 300 650 4000 6.15 As of Patch February 2, 2026 tokens drop in 4 new areas highlighted in red, the Rift area is the original location for them: Karkasse Ridgelands Hasla Editor's Note on weapon progression (Opinion) The general and oft-repeated consensus on progressing Emerald weaponry from Unique to Divine grade is to use six T3 weapons. This method was presented to us upon the release of these weapons and has remained the most commonly provided "answer" when players ask how best to progress. While the strictly "best" approach likely varies based on personal circumstances and differences in drop rates, the ongoing friction and absolutism surrounding this topic have led me to include this brief opinion piece. On a case-by-case basis, further optimizations may be possible. However, it is the opinion of this editor that progressing the weapon via the synthesis of 28 T1 weapons will, on average, be the preferred approach when optimizing primarily for minimal farming time. At the most basic level, my rationale is as follows: It allows for earlier progression from Unique → Celestial grade, resulting in a non-negligible increase in farming speed. While this method requires more labor, in the grand scheme of progression, 500 labor is not a significant amount, and the time saved easily compensates for this cost. Even with the presence of the token conversion recipe, a player is likely to accumulate 4,200 tokens (in increments of 150) of any type before reaching the specific requirement of 650 in six out of the seven token types. Ultimately, every player should make an informed decision on how best to progress in their own scenario—and, most importantly, remember to have fun. - Silverbranch Changing your Emerald weapon Should you change your mind after crafting your Emerald weapon, look under the Hasla: Emerald Destruction category at the workbench in the Abandoned Drill Camp. It offers crafts which destroy your subsequent weapon in order to return the Infused Emerald. No synthesis experience you've committed to your current weapon will be saved, and you'll be forced to start over from scratch. Addons are small mods made to the game's UI, creating new ways of displaying information or giving utility to players. Installing Addons Recommended: Addon Manager The best way to install addons is to use the Addon Manager created by Sami. You can download it on Github here: https://github.com/classic-addon-manager/classic-addon-manager/releases By downloading "classic-addon-manager.exe". When you open it, you'll be able to browse addons and install them at the click of a button! Installing manually You can also install addons manually by downloading the source code of an addon. You can then extract the source code into a folder located in Documents/AAClassic/Addon/... Then, in your addons.txt file, write the name of the folder so that the game knows about it! Creating Addons More documentation will be given soon about how to create your own addons. In the meantime, check on Discord as some examples are there! You can also read the Addon API

Anchoring Emblems Overview Anchoring Emblems are essential tools in upgrading equipment without the risk of breakage. They come in two varieties: Celestial and Divine, each corresponding to the enhancement of Celestial or Divine-grade Weapons, Accessories, or Armor. This page outlines the crafting process, materials needed for their creation and use. Crafting Anchoring Emblems Materials Required Anchoring Emblem recipe To craft an Anchoring Emblem, you will need to visit one of the following locations, along with the required materials of 100 Shards and 2 Honorforged Medals (Available from the Honor Shop): Masonry Workbench: Requires 130,000 Masonry Proficiency Select Community Centers with Improved Workbenches (Level 2 or higher): Does not require Proficiency. Obtaining Shards Shards are salvaged from Epherium or Delphinad equipment. Note that only equipment of Unique grade or higher qualifies for salvaging. The number of shards obtained depends on the slot of Equipment: Weapons Any weapon: 55 Shards Available "Lone Stones" Armor Hood: 33 Shards Chest: 55 Shards Waist: 21 Shards Sleeves: 21 Shards Gloves: 33 Shards Pants: 42 Shards Boots: 33 Shards Accessories Any accessory: 55 Shards To salvage equipment, you must craft and use a "Lone Stone", of the respective Sun, Moon or Star type, which requires 50,000 Alchemy Proficiency as well as one of the respective Archeum Essence in order to craft. Crafting Locations Without Proficiency Level 3 Community Center If you lack Masonry Proficiency, you can craft Anchoring Emblems at Improved Workbenches in Level 2 or higher Community Centers. These locations include: Marianople Hellswamp Sanddeep Halcyona Falcorth Plains Rookborne Basin Windscour Savannah To check the level of a Community Center, view the green bars at the bottom right of your map (Default 'M') in the corresponding zone. A fully leveled Community Center displays three green bars.

The Supplying the Settlers event is also known as "Daru Chefs" or "Sushi" event. Goals and Rewards The event consists of three activities: Collecting Pure Ice by breaking Diamond Shores icebergs, and bringing it to Freedich outposts. The Pure Ice can then be inserted into the Ice Boxes next to the Sushi Chef. Make sure to accept the quest from the nearby NPC to recieve a reward of 30 Lord's Pence for your contribution. Each outpost contains 5 Ice Boxes A single Pure Ice trade pack is enough to fill an Ice Box, granting it 3 charges, which along with a Fish Fillet, allows you to produce a Fish Food Supply pack. Once a Ice Box has been emptied, it'll take somewhere between 10 - 15 minutes to properly clean, before you're able to use it again! Collecting Fish Fillets by bringing Saltwater Fish to the Sushi Chef Fish Fillets can be acquired by supplying the Sushi Chef with freshly caught Sports Fish Fry and normal size fish will provide 2 fillets per fish. Gargantuan sized fish will provide between 3 and 4 filets. Fish Fillets are tradeable, and do not have an expiry, allowing you to stock up! Creating Fish Food Supply packs by interacting with a filled Ice Box while having a Fish Fillet in your inventory and bringing the created packs to one of the 6 Auroran Settlers camps. These are the areas in Sungold Fields, Calmlands, Marcala, Heedmar, Nuimari, and Exeloch, which are annoted with the "Faction Base" icons on your map. As a reward for your efforts during this event, you will be rewarded with Lord's Pence, allowing a new way for users to generate Lord's Coins, whilst not being part of a ruling castle guild. You will recieve - 30 Lord's Pence per Ice Pack succesfully delivered to the Daru Chef's Ice Boxes. 70 Lord's Pence per Fish Food Supply pack succesfully delivered to the Auroran Settlers.

h: How to acquire and use Armor Autographs.
How to acquire and use Weapon Autographs.
x: Aria's Autographs are unsealable items, which allow players to choose a piece of Mistsong equipment when opened. ArcheAge classic features both Weapon Autographs, as well as new custom Armor Autographs. GHA (Greater Howling Abyss), GKC (Greater Krolal Cradle) and Mistsong equipment, due to their classification as "Dungeon" items, fall within the "Easy" path of regrades making them significantly easier to regrade than their crafted counterparts, any regrades performed upon GHA and GKC equipment prior to their conversion to Autograph's will remain, and you will reveal a Mistsong piece of the equivalent grade. This system provides an alternative way for new players to progress, with Mistsong equipment viable either as a stepping stone, or, as part of an end-game build due to the ease of availability, and overall scaleability. When an autograph is right clicked to unseal, it will provide a choice of any item within its type, a player could craft a weapon autograph using a scepter, and reveal a bow, or craft an armor autograph with a cloth belt, and reveal a plate chest. Autograph's are crafted using the "Distorted Mistsong Workbench" located in Mistmerrow. Aria's Armor Autograph Example Armor Regrade and Autograph crafts. How to acquire and use Armor Autographs. Acquiring Aria's Armor Autographs requires preparation and materials. The process involves the following steps: Gather Greater Howling Abyss (GHA) or Greater Krolaol Cradle Armor Materials: Players must first obtain armor pieces and regrade materials. Players searching for armor pieces should complete Greater Howling Abyss aswell as Greater Kroloal Cradle as these are a source of both equipment pieces and regrade materials. Other Greater Dungeon's may be ran for their regrade material drops, but do not drop autographable armor pieces. <Optional> Regrade the Armor: Players are reccomended to use this opportunity to regrade the armor to their desired grade, preventing the potential wastage of destroying the weapon during the regrade process after comitting precious resources to its upgrading and subsequent autographing. Important: Whilst regrade scrolls will be required to take armor pieces beyond Celestial grade, prior to this players can regrade pieces deterministically with a guarentee of success via the "Distorted Dimension Workbench" which can be found outside of Greater Dungeons. These recipes require materials found within dungeons, some of which are tradeable and can be found on the auction house. Alongside 100 Labour. Autograph the Armor piece: The Armor can then be upgraded into an Aria's Autograph through a crafting recipe at the "Distorted Mistsong Workbench" located at Mistmerrow. Reveal the Mistsong Armor piece: Right click the Autograph to reveal the Mistsong Armor piece of your choice. Aria's Weapon Autograph Example Autograph craft. How to acquire and use Weapon Autographs. Acquiring Aria's Weapon Autographs requires preparation and materials. The process involves the following steps: Gather Tier 1 Greater Howling Abyss (GHA) Weapons and Materials: Players must first obtain a Tier 1 Greater Howling Abyss weapon and the materials involved in its upgrading to its Tier 2 form. This can be achieved by completing the Greater Howling Abyss and collecting the necessary loot drops. <Optional> Regrade the Weapon: Players are reccomended to use this opportunity to regrade the weapon to their desired grade, preventing the potential wastage of destroying the weapon during the regrade process after comitting precious resources to its upgrading and subsequent autographing. Upgrade the GHA Weapon to Tier 2: Upgrade the weapon at the "Distorted Dimension Workbench" outside of the dungeon into its Tier 2 form. Autograph the GHA Weapon: The weapon can then be upgraded into an Aria's Autograph through a crafting recipe at the "Distorted Mistsong Workbench" located at Mistmerrow. Reveal the Mistsong Weapon: Right click the Autograph to reveal the Mistsong Weapon of your choice. Upgrade the Mistsong Weapon: The Mistsong weapon revealed will be in its Tier 1 form, Mistsong weapons feature 3 Tiers, and must be fully upgraded to unlock their true potential. Materials for these upgrades can be bought on the auction house, or acquired via completion of Mistsong Summit.

Getting there Ahnimar Festival Grounds The Ahnimar Founder's Festival, as the name implies, takes place in Ahnimar. Specifically the Tadpole Tail Field and Lotus Song Garden regions. You can make your way here yourself, or make use of the festival world gates found in your faction capitals. Taking Part Once you arrive at the Ahnimar community center you'll be head to the Lotus Song Gardens to speak with Eggwarden Dolbu, who offers festival tokens in exchange for your help in caring for Daru eggs. Raising Daru Eggs After collecting your Daru Egg Cradle from Father Dolbu, you'll need to incubate it within a Daru Egg Incubator, which you can find nearby. Once your egg is moistened you'll need to locate one of the Lillypad Nursery's, place your egg down, and follow the prompts to give it all the care a growing Daru needs. Once your egg is happy, it'll fall asleep, and you'll have to come back after 10 minutes to discover what type of Daru hatchling you've been caring for. As different egg types, result in different numbers of rewards. In total, there are 5 different types of Daru that you may have been raising, once returned to the Eggwarden, you'll receive differently sized rewards: Residency Daru Egg (1 Festival Coins) Salesman Daru Egg (2 Festival Coins) Captain Daru Egg (3 Festival Coins) Trade Outlet Daru Egg (3 Festival Coins) Astra-Blessed Daru Egg (5 Festival Coins) Incapacitiating hungry Skyfins Achoo needs your help. The local Skyfin population has been known to steal Daru Eggs! Take the Skyfin Sedative they supply, and help sedate the Skyfin before they can steal the eggs. Interact with the stone behind Achoo to be moved to the hill top the Skyfin's favour. You'll be rewarded with 2 Festival Coins for your effort. Help build Daru Egg incubators Festival Keep Aliniri needs help constructing Daru Egg Incubators, deliver 50 Iron Ingots 100 Lumber (2026) and receive 3 Festival Coins as a reward. Dig for hidden Treasure At [1PM], [7PM], and [12AM] server-time (EST) the Ahnimar Rainbow will appear over Lotus Song Garden, head over and speak to Ian to take part in a treasure hunt. Sand Mounds will appear, player's will have to dig through these mounds in search of lost Daru Treasure Chests, once they've been found, interact with them to receive 2 Festival Coins. Rewards

NOTE : The drop quality and hasla token event has been extended until the 2nd of April, however the legacy's end boxes ended as expected on the 19th, Good news! GHA and GKC armors will drop directly at UNIQUE instead of ARCANE, making it even cheaper to work on your armor! Check out the Aria's Autograph page for more information! The amount of Hasla Tokens dropped has been doubled, making it easier to level up your Emerald Weapon! Various dailies will reward a "Legacy's End Box". This box will give a choice between a Legacy's End Reward or Arctic Earthstones. Community Goals Community Goals is a new feature introduced in Patch 1.3.5, launching on Wednesday, April 2nd. This system encourages players to set aside their conflicts and work together toward a common objective set by the enigmatic Daru. Overview The Daru, long known for their love of trade and wealth, have grown concerned over the relentless wars and bloodshed across the lands of Nuia and Haranya. Believing that harmony and cooperation can be just as rewarding as conflict, they have devised a new challenge for all adventurers. Each month, players will be given a global task to complete within a limited timeframe; and before too much bloodshed has occured. These objectives will require the combined efforts of all participants on a server, reinforcing the need for collaboration. Objectives The specific objectives for each month's Community Goal will vary, but they may include tasks such as: Gathering and donating vast quantities of resources. Crafting and delivering specialty trade packs. Defeating dangerous world bosses collaboratively. Constructing large-scale public projects. Emoting /hug a set number of times Giving Aguru a nice foot rub The progress of the Community Goal will be tracked in real-time, allowing all players to monitor how close they are to success. Rewards Should the players successfully complete the assigned task before the deadline and before the Daru become dismayed by the violence, the Daru will bestow a valuable reward upon all contributors. For the inaugural challenge in Patch 1.3.5, the reward is the highly coveted Rocket Wings #2 Magithopter Failure and Retries If the Community Goal is not completed within the timeframe, or if too many PvP deaths occur whilst the event is ongoing, players will not receive the reward and must wait until the following month for a new challenge. However, each new cycle presents a fresh opportunity to claim valuable prizes. Participation All players may contribute to the Community Goal, regardless of faction or level. Contributions are cumulative, meaning that even small efforts will aid in the overall progress. The Daru encourage all adventurers to put aside their rivalries and work towards the greater good—at least for the duration of the event.

h: I sealed my equipment, then what?
x: Obsidian Transmuters are a new feature introduced in Patch 1.3.5, allowing players to transform one piece of Obsidian Equipment into another of the same slot. This system provides greater flexibility in gear progression and enables players to adjust their equipment to better suit their needs without starting from scratch. Overview The Daru, ever the pioneers of mysterious technology, have been experimenting with the nature of Obsidian Equipment. After much research (and an undisclosed number of lab explosions), they have devised a method to reshape these powerful items. However, their work conditions have led to unrest, as the Daru have begun threatening to unionize, refusing to reveal the crafting process until they receive proper compensation—specifically, Gilda-Starry-Stars. Despite this labor dispute, transmuters have been successfully introduced, and adventurers can begin using them immediately to alter their gear. How does transmuters work? There are different seals that can be crafted from the Alchemy proficiency in order to seal different tier of weapons or armors. The 'lesser' seals can be used to seal Tier 6 Obsidian weapons/armors (Divine, Epic and Legendary) The 'brimstone' seals can be used to seal Tier 7 Obsidian weapons/armors (Epic) The 'greater brimstone' seals can be used to seal Tier 7 Obsidian weapons/armors (Legendary and Mythic) I sealed my equipment, then what? Under 'Weaponry' proficiency craft recipes, you can find the 'Archeum Transmutation' section. There, you can use the sealed shard you obtained, and using some extra materials you can get your desired weapon or armor.

A guide to help you navigate through tricky or unclear parts of the Main Story Questline in ArcheAge Classic. Introduction In ArcheAge Classic, progressing through the Main Story Questline (MSQ) is essential for leveling. However, players often find themselves lost when the follow-up quest doesn't appear at the same NPC or area as the previous hand-in. This guide is here to help! This page outlines commonly confusing spots in the MSQ for each race, and provides direct links to NPCs on the ArcheAge Codex database and images of their location to help you find your way. General MSQ Tips If the follow-up quest doesn’t appear at the NPC where you turned in your last quest: Open your Options → Game Info, scroll to the bottom, and set the Quest Details Map Display slider to Unlimited. This setting allows all available quests to be shown on your world map, which is especially helpful when navigating the MSQ, as follow-up quests are sometimes given by NPCs in a different location. Harani MSQ Navigation Issues Chapter 2.1 Quest: Innocent Victims NPC: Ramusi Tip: This quest starts in a different region. You can find it in Tigerspine Mountains along the road connected to Arcum Iris. Chapter 6.2 Quest: A Shadowhawk's Request NPC: Ataka Tip: This quest starts in a different region. You can find it in Silent Forest - Harani Campsite. Firran MSQ Navigation Issues Chapter 6.2 Quest: An Old Friend NPC: Shavnik Tip: This quest starts in a different region. You can find it in Silent Forest - Vedisa. Nuia / Haranya (Shared) MSQ Navigation Issues Chapter 7.1 Quest: Your Legend Continues NPC: Gleeman Orneon Tip: This chapter starts in a different region. You can find the quest in Cinderstone Moore - Burnt Castle Camp (for Nuia Continent) or Ynystere - Bulwark (for Haranya Continent) depending on which faction you are.

Stat migration is really important part of character growth in AAC. Its basically choosing to move points from another stat to another. Lets say i play a healer i want my main stat to be Spirit since i need it for healing. Secondary stat should be Stamina since it makes me tankier by giving Max HP and Parry Rate so i live longer. So id move points from stats like Strength and Agility into Spirit and Stamina. Stat migration window Stat migration can be accessed through character profile and on the second to bottom section. The cogwheel on the right side will open the stat migration window. There is total of 300 migration points a player is able to allocate as they wish. Main stats by class Healer (Cleric, Hierophant) Spirit > Stamina Tank (Skullnight, Nightcloak) Full Stamina Tank (Abolisher) Stamina > Strength or Strength > Stamina, based on preference Archer (Primeval, Ebonsong) Full Agility Mage (Spellsinger, Spellsong, Revenant) Full Intelligence Melee (Darkrunner, Bloodreaver) Gear dependent. Must have minimum 750 Strength in order to get 100% melee accuracy. After that Agility. Migration Items Migration Talisman Migration Talismans are the books players can buy from the General Merchant with 50 gold each. When clicked the book lets players to choose a Talisman. Talisman is the item that defines which stat you turn into which. Str > Spi, Agi > Spi, Sta > Spi, Int > Spi and so on. The book you buy is the book u want the stat go into. Talismans move 5 points each time used. Can be used once a day but more times with increased amount of talismans. Lets say i use one talisman to move stats. If i want to do it the same day again i need to buy 2 talismans to move 5 points again. Luminous Migration Talisman These books can be bought from Evenbards with 5 gold each. To open the book to get the Talisman players must buy 10 Honor Badges from Honor Shop. Once its open the Talisman works just like the other one but gives 10 points. Same day penalty applies to the evenbard talismans too. Migration Scale Players will have 200 stat points by default. To increase the amount players needs to buy Migration Scale from Merit Shop with 100 Merit Badges. Migration Scalpel Migration Scalpel reset all the stats player has allocated and loses them. Player has to buy all the migration talismans again to allocate the points on the stat they want. Migration Stone Migration Stone can be crafted with 300 Honor Badges that can be bought from Honor Shop. With this stone the points can be reset and changed into 2x 150 point talismans and allocated again. More like an endgame item where the player has all 300 stat points allocated and wants to roll class or otherwise change the stats.

Mining can be an easy way to earn gold when starting out or a decent income for veteran players. With the combination of Luke’s Helping Hand buff, Dawnsdrop gear, family buffs, and statue buffs, you can reach around 42,000 Mining proficiency quite easily even as a beginner. If you can’t join a high-level family right away, don’t worry — it’s only about 5,000 proficiency you’re missing. The reason all these buffs are listed is because once you reach 50,000 Mining proficiency (with buffs), you can begin mining Anya Pebbles, which sell for a good amount on the Auction House (press **"P"** by default). You can burn labor very quickly mining Anya Pebbles, or you can mine smaller amounts and refine them into Anya Ingots, which sell for even more but require much more labor to produce. Getting Started Begin by mining *dig sites*. West (Nuia): Excavation Site in Dewstone Plains. East (Haranya): Halo Hollow in Solis Headlands. East (Haranya): Glitterstone Mine in Ynystere (Ynystere is a conflict zone which means there can be PvP combat from both west and east players) Sell your ores and ingots to build up starting gold. Once you have enough gold, buy a pair of Dawnsdrop Fists (if you haven’t already). The mining speed bonus applies regardless of item level. Higher-tier Dawnsdrop fists will bring you closer to efficiently farming Anya Pebbles. Iron Vein Locations Iron Vein Nodes Nuia Haranya Progression 0-50k Mining: Focus on ores from dig sites, sell raw materials or craft ingots. 50k+ Mining (with buffs): Continue farming and investing in better Dawnsdrop fists. 50k+ Mining (with buffs): Start farming **Anya Pebbles** for steady profit. Tips Always check Auction House (*P*) to see whether raw ores or refined ingots are selling for more profit. Mining consumes labor quickly — plan your sessions around labor regen or potions. Joining a family and stacking buffs will accelerate your mining progression. Invest in Dawnsdrop fists as soon as possible for faster mining speed and faster progression towards mining anya. If you have the option to use some of your guildies land to use their miner's farmhouse drills i'd highly recommend it as single mining ores can be tiresome. UNDER DEVELOPMENT

Have you ever wondered what "stolen Heedmar/Calmlands/Marcala/Nuimari goods are being opened" means? Well, this guide will hopefully fill in the gaps. If you want to see how working on a castle functions, check out this guide: Working on a Castle. Warehouses By working on a castle and turning in 90 packs to the merchants at the marketplace, it will generate 30 packs that the ruling guild can interact with. These can then be taken to any of the castle zones that have silos and a fortress at Tier 2. - If you deliver the territory goods to the zone they were created in, it will yield 1 full LC (Lord's Coin) per pack. - If you bring the goods to a different zone than where they were created, each pack will yield 150 pence (1.5 LC). A silo can hold up to 30 packs, resulting in either 30 LC (if delivered locally) or 45 LC (if delivered to a different zone). Full Warehouse When a warehouse is full, there are two possible approaches — but in both cases, the ruling guild must open it for vulnerability. 1. Loot & Steal: Once vulnerable, any enemy guild (red to the ruling guild) can steal one pack / goods per warehouse, either directly from the warehouse or from someone who loots them. If looted and opened, each pack yields 10 LC. 2. Defend & Reward: Alternatively, the ruling guild can leave the warehouse open for 2 hours while defending it. If successful, the Lord of the Castle will receive 15 Lord's Coins in the mail the following day. ``` After the 2 hour defending period is over or someone has looted the warehouse for the 1 pack the warehouse will go on a timer until it will be ready to be filled again.

The Abyssal Attack occurs multiple times throughout the week. You can check the in-game calendar or the [AAC website]timers for specific times. This event involves several stages and mechanics, all leading to the restoration of Ezi's Light in the Sea of Graves. Luscas and Abyssal Kraken When the Abyssal Attack begins, Luscas and the Abyssal Kraken spawn at the center of the Sea of Graves. This location is south of Heedmar and north of Freedich Island (check your map for exact positioning). If you are present at the start, you may notice various items and surprises floating in the water around the island. The objective is to kill all Luscas and the Kraken to progress to the next phase. Restoring Ezi's Light Once the Abyssal Kraken is defeated, a server-wide message will announce that the restoration of Ezi's Light is now possible. To restore the light, head to the foot of the monument in the Sea of Graves and interact with the beacon on the pedestal. This action begins a three-minute channel that must be completed without interruption. Enemies can stop the restoration in two ways: - Killing the player who is channeling - Destroying the lodestones located to the north, east, or west of the monument (these are marked on your map) Lodestones must be destroyed using siege damage (such as from cannons). If they are successfully destroyed, the beacon will explode, dealing 20,000 damage and knocking back anyone nearby into the dangerous waters surrounding the monument.

The 8x8 are the smallest kind of land a person can own in the game. Mostly these are new players best friend when finding their first land. There are few kinds of 8x8 designs and the most common one being scarecrows that usually stage packs. Gardens are a safe place to grow plants, raise livestock, and store trade packs without fear of thieves. Scarecrow Garden The normal scarecrow design can be acquired from Blue Salt Brotherhood quest when leveling. Each faction has their own map where the questline starts from. As an East player the quest begins at Tigerspine Community Center and for West players the questline begins at Lilyut Hills Community Center. Awesome guidevideo made by Hamilton that explains in a detail how to get it. It can be obtained from the quest only once by character. Scarecrow garden, once placed, needs to be built with materials. The scarecrow is located in the middle of the plot so it doesn't have as much space as the Full Kit ones. The Scarecrow Design cant be sold or made into full kit. Construction materials in order Pack Icon Amount Lumber 1 Full Kit When a design has a "Full Kit" in its name it means that the design, once placed on the ground, doesn't need to be built. Usually a buildings need all kinds of materials to be used in order to build it. Only the Full Kits are exception to this. If player decides to demolish the scarecrow the design will remain as a Full Kit to be placed again without building it. Full Kit: Solar Scarecrow Solar Scarecrow design can be bought from the Gilda section of the Marketplace with 150 Gilda Stars. The Scarecrow is located on the side of the plot and can be rotated around the plot when placing. Full Kit: Stellar Scarecrow Stellar Scarecrow design can be bought from the Merit section of the Marketplace with 150 Merit Badges. The Scarecrow is located on the side of the plot and can be rotated around the plot when placing. Full Kit: Lunar Scarecrow Lunar Scarecrow design can be bought from the Loyalty section of the Marketplace with 150 Loyalty Tokens. The Scarecrow is located on the side of the plot and can be rotated around the plot when placing. Private Workbench Workbenches are those buildings that have the same crafting stations, same as the NPC:s do, in certain places of the map. The workbenches can be build closer to players house or location of buildings being built to have the same crafting ability closer and no need for running back and forth with the crafted packs or items. There are two types of workbenches in the game. One being "Private Workbench" and other being "Haranyan Private Workbench". The only difference between these two are looks. They both cost the same amount to buy the design and need same amount of materials to be built. Private Workbench and Haranyan Private Workbench cost 30 Gilda Stars and they can be bought in Mirage Isle from their respective sides of the island. Private Workbenches can be sold but they cannot be made into Full Kit. Nuian style workbenches, located on the right side of the island when entering Mirage. Tax Certificates or just "Taxes" are the so called currency to pay for the housing the player owns. Taxes can be crafted by the players and sold in the Auction house. There are two type of Taxes, one that's is tradeable and one that is untradeable. The unbound taxes are more expensive to craft and require the minimum of 230k Construction proficiency. Prepay Taxes can be paid beforehand. Reasons like IRL stuff can require the player to be away from the game for some time or if one just wants to avoid the tax paying hassle every week. Taxes can be prepaid for 5 times and 1 prepay is for 7 days. So in total 5 weeks can be prepaid. Each time player prepays one week more the amount of taxes needed to be paid increase.

Proficiencies are the key to harvesting, crafting and producing goods in Archeage. They are certain skills the character can learn and level up to be better at certain craft. The higher the level of the proficiency the less Labor cost and time spent making the items. Proficiency category limits There are 3 proficiency categories which are: Harvesting, Crafting and Special. Each proficiency can be leveled by the player but all of the proficiencies cant be maxed out so it balances out the gameplay and lets some players be professionals in some areas than others. The maximum level of Famed can be only 2 from Harvesting, 3 from Crafting and 2 from Special. Everything else can be leveled up to level 10 with Specialization snowflakes mentioned below. Harvesting Gathering the materials from the open world or player farms and gardens. Husbandry Growing livestock one by one, pens or Ranchers farmhouse. Usual things to do are milk, wool, fresh fertilizer. Farming Consists of all kinds of grains and produces. Fishing As the name implies, fish. Can be done as sportfishing or fish traps with aquafarms. Logging Cutting trees. Gathering Gathering all kinds of flowers and herbs. Mining Different kind of minerals and metals that can be later turn into items. Crafting Crafting the items such as gear pieces, weapons, vehicles, gliders, jewels and so on. Alchemy Potions and buffs. Cooking Food buffs. Quests First time when meeting Death in Two Crowns player is given two options, to live or to die. First time has to be picked Decide to die so the questline begins and player becomes a Deathbringer. [Wanted: Mortals of Erenor] Death collects souls of those that player has killed. He asks the players to go to Halcyona and reap 3 players there and come back. Once the stacks reach 500 all the mortals around him will be rewarded. [Wanted: Duckling] A quest where Death hands and chick for the player and they need to reap it. Place it down and use the skill. Broom Race Location Broom Race is located inside Mirage Island. The portal is located right down the stairs when entered. Quests [Hallowtide Challenge] Introduction to the place. [Hallowtide Broom Race] Little Witch instructs the player how to do the race and gives temporary Broom glider. Race starts when a player summons the glider normally. The broom moves up and down and turns faster than the normal gliders do. Goal is to stay on the path of the pumpkin icons to get the speed buff often as possible. Route takes player through 4 gates and those gates need to be passed in order to finish the quest. There is additional rewards for hitting certain amount of pumpkins in a row or making the race in certain timeframe. The tomb stone shaped Task Board will tell additional info on how to complete the race. [Well Done!] After completing all the gates Little Witch sends the quest item into players inventory. By clicking it it starts a quest called Well Done! that can be completed at the end of the racetrack by talking to Little Witch. Rewards For this event the currency is different than the normal Daru Festival Coin. The currency to buy these items is Broom Race coin. Icon Reward Stormduster 1000 glider "Mischievous" title, cosmetic title Serendipity Stone Workers Compensation: 1000

Hanure the Berserker 💜 Hanure the Berserker is a relentless melee boss built around raw aggression and pressure. Found in AA Classic, this boss has a range of mechanics that can make it difficult to kill it contested. it's up for two hours ( check AAC webpage for timers ) Abilities & Keywords Powerful Overwhelm This ability is triggered when the tank / target of the boss is out of melee range ( it then leaps to the target) Berserker’s Ruins Debris falling down from the air stunning players and healing hanure ( per enemy hit ) Sharp Breath A focused, cutting exhale of compressed force aimed in a frontal cone. only tank should be infront of this boss. Heavenly Smash Hanure leaps or channels his strength into a devastating overhead strike, dealing massive area damage on impact. This is his signature burst ability and often signals a high-damage phase. Players should watch for the wind-up animation and move quickly to avoid lethal hits. if you have a cleanse or purge look to help people hit. Boss Traits High physical burst damage Strong anti-cluster mechanics Tank pressure and sustain checks Positional awareness required Rage-themed melee bruiser

Location Event is located in White Arden, Ardenia, Nuia side. Quests [The Ghost Wedding] Arden Guard Finis starts the questline and he asks the player to talk to Delmin closer to the event area. [Hauntingly Beautiful] Delmin needs 3 Hereaftter Roses that can be picked up close at nearby tree. Gather tree and go back to Delmin. [A Good Cause] Delmin gives another quest where she wants the player to craft an Donation Envelope (click envelope icon) and donating it into the box next to her. After donating go back to her. After donating the envelope Delmin will reward the player with the Guardian Token that can be used on the Groom and Pride to receive a Wedding Buff. Receive buff by going close to the NPC:s and click F with the Guardian Token in the inventory. The buff lasts for 60min. [The Wedding Crasher] Arden Guard Musician gives a quest to drive away a singing bard and investigate Suspicious Pirate Plushie. The Singing Bard appears at certain hours where players need to drive him away. After he is gone there will be the Plushie spawning that need to be investigated so the quest is completed. For the EU region, the Singing Bard appears at 2pm, 7pm and 12am UTC. For the NA region, the Singing Bard appears at 7pm, 12am and 5am UTC. [Stranded in White Arden] Eldest Princess Esana gives a quest and asks for 3 BOUND Hereafter stones so she can teleport back to Haranya. [Till Death Do us Part] Dias needs help with crafting the wedding rings. Had to the Festival Gift Exchanger. Craft Wedding Ring with 3 BOUND Hereafter stones. After crafting go back to him.

New map area that opened in the Patch 1.3.5u || Winter Patch. Located in Miroir Tundra is now a Snowfang Village. The Isle got the basic crafting stations, seed and livestock merchants as well as their own housing. In Snowfang Isle only Igloo houses survive so other types of houses can't be placed. Snowfang Isle's climate is subarctic and the zone is ongoing peace zone with no war cycle. Getting around Normal vehicles won't work there so players can rent a sleigh from Sleigh Rental Slopeng. Sleigh will be usable for 15min and they cost 15 gold each. Slopeng is located in the middle of the Isle. Housing Housing on Snowfang Isle consists only of Igloo houses since other houses can't take the extreme cold. There are few housing areas around the Isle and more are to be opened when they are filling. Igloo design can be bought with 150 Gilda stars. Questline [Miroir Tundra] Questline starts with Alfensa who is located in the middle of the Isle. She wants the player to talk to Catari. [Alfensa's Request] Catari is the Warehouse Manager Daru almost next to Alfensa. Talk to him and go back to Alfensa. [First Contact] Alfensa wants the player to go and greet Princess Penguin on the Isle. [The Royal Colony] After talking to Princess Penguin she recommends the player to go and introduce themselves to the Prince Penguin. Prince can be found close to their father at royal court. !! If Prince cant be found on hes usual spot might be that some total monkey has pushed pinguins around and he can be found nearby in the water!! [The King, Penguini] Prince Penguin is displeased that players don't talk to hes father the King first. King is nearby. [The Upcoming Winter] King tells players to ask Prince what can be done to help the colony. [Return to Princess] Prince Penguin asks the players to go send word for Princess to come back home soon. [A Royal Request] Prince asks players to help 3 sickly penguins around the Isle. Use the Penguin Healing Potion on the sickly ones to cure them. Sick penguins have green smoke coming from them and buff called "Able to be penguin healed". [Trick or...penguin?!] Trick 3 penguins with manure on the Isle. Use the manure on the pinguins. [A Dance for Penguins!] Use the drum to dance in front of the Miroir Emperor Penguins 3 times. Use the drum on the penguins. [An Audience with the King] Talk to the king. [A Tasty Fish] King needs help from the players. Get 100 shrimp and use the quest item to turn the shrimp to Minced Seafood. After acquiring the Minced Seafood talk to the King. [A Tasty Fish 2] Get Glacier Clayfish and mince it too. Glacier Clayfish can be fished out of the Miroir Tundra ice fishing spots or bought from AH. Talk to the King. [A Tasty Fish 3] King needs the players help to catch a Bluefin Tuna and mince it like in the previous quests. Bluefin Tuna can be found around the world and fished from Tuna schools. The Blue Fin Tuna has to be Fry one! King Penguino will reward the player with Miroir Everfrost that is a material to craft Snowflake Wings. Snowflake Wings Snowflake Wings are a magitopher and are able to glide on the spot for long time. Their special skill called wrongly in the buff bar is Twilight Flight which makes the user invisible to other players for 3 seconds starting from the moment the glider is deployed.
