Shows an in-game style tooltip for a glider, fetched from the sermeatball API. Usage {{Glider|8001101}} The only required parameter is the item ID of the glider. The data is read from data pages stored on the wiki (Module:Data/Gliders/..., made by sync_wiki_data.py). A glider that is not stored yet is read live from the API until the script has been run for it. The icon is the game's own icon of the glider (from the glider API); if that file is not on the wiki, the file named after the glider is used. The name, description and the flight stats (speed, gliding, turning, launch height, special skills) come from the API, with the colours of the game. float (optional): where the card sits on the page. right or left places it at that side with the text flowing around it, center centres it. Leave it out for a normal card in the flow of the page. Each special skill gets its own row, and is hoverable. The skill IDs come from the glider part of the API (/wiki/glider/<id>), matched by skill name. A skill the API does not list is shown as coloured text. Module:GliderSkillIds is optional now: an ID written there is only used for a skill the API did not give. use (optional): replaces the "Use:" text. Normally the standard glider text is used, and Magithopters (descriptions with "Air Speed") get the Magithopter text. The "Equip effect" text is written in the module. Needs Module:Glider, Module:IconName, Template:Grade, Template:GliderSkillRow, Template:GliderSkill (and through it Module:Mount and Template:Mount/styles.css) and Template:Glider/styles.css. Examples {{Glider|8001101}} {{Glider|8001101|float=right}} No description. Template parameters Parameter Description Type Status Item ID 1 The item ID of the glider, for example 8001101 Number required Position float Optional. Where the card sits on the page: right or left (text flows around it) or center. Leave empty for a normal card in the flow of the page. Suggested values right left center String optional Use text use Optional. Replaces the "Use:" text of the card. Leave empty to use the standard text. String optional

local p = {} local IconName = require('Module:IconName') local Store = require('Module:DataStore') -- data stored on the wiki by sync_wiki_data.py local Mount = require('Module:Mount') -- its hover box for a skill -- Optional manual list: skill name -> skill ID. Only used for skills the API did not give an ID for. local okIds, SkillIds = pcall(require, 'Module:GliderSkillIds') if not okIds or type(SkillIds) ~= 'table' then SkillIds = {} end -- "Glider Charge" and "glider charge!" are the same skill local function key(s) return (tostring(s or ''):lower():gsub('[^%a%d]', '')) end -- The skills as sent by Template:Glider: "id¦name‖id¦name‖..." -> key(name) -> id local function parseSkillIds(str) str = tostring(str or '') local ids = {} if str:find('class="error"', 1, true) then return ids end for _, row in ipairs(mw.text.split(str, '‖', true)) do local f = mw.text.split(row, '¦', true) local id, name = tonumber(mw.text.trim(f[1] or '')), mw.text.trim(f[2] or '') if id and name ~= '' and not ids[key(name)] then ids[key(name)] = math.floor(id) end end return ids end -- Make text safe to put inside HTML / wikitext local function esc(s) return mw.text.encode(tostring(s or ''), '<>&"\'%[%]{}|') end local function trim(s) return mw.text.trim(tostring(s or '')) end -- Colours of the game's short codes: |nc;...|r is orange, |ni;...|r is yellow ("Immune to |ni;Turbulence|r"). -- Other short codes (|nd; |nr; ...) are shown without colour. local NCODE = { c = 'FF9C27', i = 'F5CB65', d = 'A3E3FD' } -- The game marks highlighted words as |cFFRRGGBB...|r. -- Only those parts get a colour, the rest keeps the card's text colour. local function coloured(text) text = tostring(text or '') text = text:gsub('|n(%a);(.-)|r', function(code, inner) if NCODE[code] then return '|cFF' .. NCODE[code] .. inner .. '|r' end return inner end) local out, pos = {}, 1 while true do local s, e, rgb, inner = text:find('|c%x%x(%x%x%x%x%x%x)(.-)|r', pos) if not s then break end out[#out + 1] = esc(text:sub(pos, s - 1)) out[#out + 1] = '' .. esc(inner) .. '' pos = e + 1 end out[#out + 1] = esc(text:sub(pos)) return table.concat(out) end -- Where the card sits on the page (float parameter), set inline so it works without the style page local FLOATS = { right = 'float:right; clear:right; margin:0 0 0.5em 1em;', left = 'float:left; clear:left; margin:0 1em 0.5em 0;', center = 'margin:0 auto 0.5em auto;', } -- The "Use:" texts of the game (not part of the API). Magithopters have their own text. local USE_GLIDER = 'Equip a glider to glide from place to place. You can only use glider skills while airborne and will be knocked off your glider if attacked.' local USE_MAGITHOPTER = 'Equip wings to use Free Glide. You can only use glider skills while airborne, and will be knocked off your glider if you are struck by an effect that prevents movement. You will remain airborne if attacked. Gliding disables Parry, Evasion, and Shields; increases Received damage +50%.' -- key(name) -> id for the skills of a stored glider local function storedSkillIds(stored) local ids = {} for _, s in ipairs(stored.skills or {}) do if s.id and s.name and not ids[key(s.name)] then ids[key(s.name)] = math.floor(s.id) end end return ids end -- The stat lines of a glider description. Some descriptions (Arkana Wings) have no blank line between the -- story and the stats, or even write the stats after each other on one line, so a line that starts with one -- of these labels is where the stats begin. local LABELS = { 'Flight Speed', 'Air Speed', 'Gliding Ability', 'Cruising Ability', 'Turning Speed', 'Sheering Speed', 'Launch Height', 'Ascension', 'Special Skills?', 'Special Note' } local function startsWithLabel(line) for _, l in ipairs(LABELS) do if line:find('^' .. l .. ':') then return true end end return false end -- puts every label on its own line local function splitStats(desc) for _, l in ipairs(LABELS) do desc = desc:gsub('(%S)[ \t]+(' .. l .. ':)', '%1\n%2') end return desc end -- "Special Skill: Glider Charge, Instant Acceleration" -> one row per skill. -- A skill with an ID (from the API, or Module:GliderSkillIds) gets a hover box. local function skillRow(frame, label, value, apiIds) local row = mw.html.create('div'):addClass('aa-glider-skillrow') row:tag('span'):addClass('aa-glider-skilllabel'):wikitext(esc(label) .. ' ') local box = row:tag('div'):addClass('aa-glider-skills') local function add(rgb, name) name = trim(name) if name == '' then return end local html local id = apiIds[key(name)] or SkillIds[name] local sk = id and Store.get('Skills', id) if sk then -- the skill's data is stored on the wiki: no request needed html = Mount.hover({ args = { name = name, realname = sk.name or '', color = rgb or '', cd = sk.cd or '', cast = sk.cast or '', mana = sk.mana and tostring(sk.mana) or '', desc = sk.desc or '', icon = sk.icon or '' } }) elseif id then html = frame:expandTemplate{ title = 'GliderSkill', args = { id = tostring(id), name = name, color = rgb or '' } } elseif rgb then html = '' .. esc(name) .. '' else html = esc(name) end box:tag('div'):wikitext(html) end local found = false for rgb, inner in value:gmatch('|c%x%x(%x%x%x%x%x%x)(.-)|r') do found = true -- the data may colour several skills as one piece ("Rocket Launch, Divebomb") for _, name in ipairs(mw.text.split(inner, ',', true)) do add(rgb, name) end end if not found then -- no colour codes in the data: split at the commas for _, name in ipairs(mw.text.split(value, ',', true)) do add(nil, name) end end return tostring(row) end -- A failed API request (with "suppress error" in the template) leaves External Data's own error text -- behind. Treat that as "no data" instead of showing it. local function fetched(s) s = trim(s) if s:find('class="error"', 1, true) then return '' end return s end function p.card(frame) local a = frame.args local stored = Store.get('Gliders', a.id) -- live data: read the skill list first, the hover boxes fetch data of their own later local apiIds = stored and storedSkillIds(stored) or parseSkillIds(a.skills) local name = stored and trim(stored.name) or fetched(a.name) if name == '' then return '' end local grade = stored and trim(stored.grade) or fetched(a.grade) local hasGrade = not (grade == '' or grade == 'None' or grade == 'Any') if not hasGrade then grade = 'Basic' end -- no grade: Basic look, and no grade line local desc = (stored and trim(stored.desc) or fetched(a.desc)):gsub('\r', '') local float = trim(a.float):lower() if not FLOATS[float] then float = '' end local isMagi = desc:find('Air Speed', 1, true) ~= nil local category = stored and trim(stored.category) or fetched(a.category) if isMagi then category = 'Magithopter' elseif category == '' then category = 'Glider' end local use = trim(a.use) if use == '' then use = isMagi and USE_MAGITHOPTER or USE_GLIDER end local root = mw.html.create('div'):addClass('aa-glider') if float == 'right' or float == 'left' then root:addClass('aa-glider-float') end if float == 'right' then root:addClass('aa-glider-right') end if float ~= '' then root:attr('style', FLOATS[float]) end -- header: icon, category, grade, name local head = root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-glider-head') head:tag('div'):addClass('aa-glider-icon'):wikitext(IconName.icon({ args = { name, grade, size = 48, file = stored and trim(stored.icon) or fetched(a.icon) } })) local title = head:tag('div'):addClass('aa-glider-title') title:tag('div'):addClass('aa-glider-cat'):wikitext(esc(category)) if hasGrade then title:tag('div'):addClass('aa-glider-grade'):wikitext( frame:expandTemplate{ title = 'Grade', args = { grade, esc(grade) } }) end title:tag('div'):addClass('aa-glider-name'):wikitext( frame:expandTemplate{ title = 'Grade', args = { grade, esc(name) } }) root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-glider-sep') -- description: the first paragraph is running text (the data may break it into short lines), -- every line after the blank line (Flight Speed, Special Skill ...) stays on its own line local lines = mw.text.split(splitStats(desc), '\n', true) local intro, i = {}, 1 while i <= #lines and trim(lines[i]) ~= '' and not startsWithLabel(trim(lines[i])) do intro[#intro + 1] = trim(lines[i]) i = i + 1 end if #intro > 0 then root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-glider-desc'):wikitext(coloured(table.concat(intro, ' '))) end local stats = root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-glider-stats') for j = i, #lines do local l = trim(lines[j]) if l ~= '' then local label, value = l:match('^(Special Skills?:)%s*(.*)$') if label then stats:wikitext(skillRow(frame, label, value, apiIds)) else -- "Special Note: Press S or ... longer. Fly in stealth for 3 seconds when Ascending." -- The sentence after the standard note is an effect of this glider: it gets its own line. local note, rest = l:match('^(Special Note:%s*Press S[^%.]*%.)%s+(%S.*)$') if note then stats:tag('div'):wikitext(coloured(note)) stats:tag('div'):wikitext(coloured(rest)) else stats:tag('div'):wikitext(coloured(l)) end end end end root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-glider-label'):wikitext('Use:') root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-glider-green'):wikitext(esc(use)) root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-glider-label'):wikitext('Equip effect') root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-glider-green'):wikitext("You can't carry another trade pack.") return tostring(root) end return p

/* Glider tooltip card (same look as the Mount card). Position comes inline from Module:Glider. */ .aa-glider { display: flow-root; position: relative; box-sizing: border-box; width: 300px; max-width: 100%; padding: 10px 12px; background: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(24, 28, 38, 0.97), rgba(10, 12, 18, 0.97)); Puts everything you give it next to each other in a row. When there is no more room the boxes continue on the next row. Any number of boxes works, there is no limit. Usage {{Div|em=0.5|first box|second box|third box}} Is the same as
first box
second box
third box
Every unnamed parameter becomes one box, in the order you write them. em (optional): the space between the boxes, in em. The default is 0.5. Empty parameters are skipped. Example {{Div|em=1|{{Mount|9002249}}|{{Mount|9002253}}|{{Mount|9002257}}}} Good to know A parameter that contains an equals sign directly in the text (for example style="color:red" in plain HTML) is read as a named parameter and disappears. Write the number in front: {{Div|1=text|2=second}}. Templates such as {{Mount|9002335|float=right}} are fine without numbers. Needs Module:Div. No description. Template parameters Parameter Description Type Status Gap em The space between the boxes, in em. Default 0.5 Default 0.5 Number optional Box 1 1 Content of the first box Content optional Box 2 2 Content of the second box Content optional Box 3 3 Content of the third box Content optional Box 4 4 Content of the fourth box. Keep adding 5, 6, 7 ... as needed, there is no limit. Content optional Box 5 5 no description Content optional Box 6 6 no description Content optional Box 7 7 no description Content optional Box 8 8 no description Content optional Box 9 9 no description Content optional Box 10 10 no description Content optional

local p = {} -- {{Div|em=0.5|first|second|third|...}} -> a flex row of <div>s that wraps when it is too wide. -- Reads the arguments of the template that called it, so there is no limit on how many you give. function p.row(frame) local args = frame:getParent().args -- gap between the boxes, in em (default 0.5) local gap = tonumber(mw.text.trim(args.em or '')) if not gap or gap < 0 then gap = 0.5 end -- collect the numbered arguments in order (1, 2, 3 ...) local keys = {} for k in pairs(args) do if type(k) == 'number' then keys[#keys + 1] = k end end table.sort(keys) local root = mw.html.create('div') :css('display', 'flex') :css('gap', gap .. 'em') :css('flex-wrap', 'wrap') local any = false for _, k in ipairs(keys) do local v = args[k] if mw.text.trim(v) ~= '' then -- empty arguments do not make an empty box root:tag('div'):wikitext(v) any = true end end if not any then return '' end return tostring(root) end return p

Row template for Template:Glider. One call per skill in the glider API, filled in by External Data (#display_external_table). It hands the skill ID and name to Module:Glider as one line of text ("id¦name‖"). Not meant to be used on its own.

local p = {} -- Reads the data that sync_wiki_data.py stored on the wiki (Module:Data/<Kind>/<number>) so the templates -- do not have to ask the APIs again and again. local IconName = require('Module:IconName') -- How many IDs share one data page. KEEP THIS IN SYNC with SHARD in sync_wiki_data.py local SHARD = { Mounts = 100, Gliders = 100, Skills = 1000, Items = 1000, Recipes = 100, Cards = 100, Pets = 100, SkillCards = 100 } local function trim(s) return mw.text.trim(tostring(s or '')) end local function esc(s) return mw.text.encode(tostring(s or ''), '<>&"\'%[%]{}|') end local loaded = {} -- One stored entry, or nil when it is not stored (yet) function p.get(kind, id) id = tonumber(id) local size = SHARD[kind] if not id or not size then return nil end id = math.floor(id) local key = kind .. '/' .. math.floor(id / size) if loaded[key] == nil then local ok, data = pcall(require, 'Module:Data/' .. key) loaded[key] = (ok and type(data) == 'table') and data or false end local data = loaded[key] return data and data[id] or nil end -- {{#invoke:DataStore|has|Mounts|8001101}} -> "1" when the data is stored, otherwise nothing function p.has(frame) return p.get(trim(frame.args[1]), frame.args[2]) and '1' or '' end -- An item by ID, for {{Item|ItemID=...}}: icon with grade border, name in the grade colour, amount. -- Args: id, amount (optional), grade (optional, replaces the item's own grade) function p.item(frame) local a = frame.args local d = p.get('Items', a.id) if not d or trim(d.name) == '' then return '' end local grade = trim(a.grade) if grade == '' then grade = trim(d.grade) end if grade == '' or grade == 'None' or grade == 'Any' then grade = 'Basic' end local out = IconName.icon({ args = { d.name, grade, file = d.icon or '', over = d.over or '' } }) .. ' ' .. frame:expandTemplate{ title = 'Grade', args = { grade, esc(d.name) } } local amount = trim(a.amount) if amount ~= '' then out = out .. ' × ' .. esc(amount) end return out end return p

local p = {} -- The recipe box built from the data stored on the wiki (sync_wiki_data.py), so the crafting API is not -- asked on every page view. Only the Recipe Cost (it follows the market) comes live: Template:RecipeBox -- sends it in the argument "cost". local IconName = require('Module:IconName') local Store = require('Module:DataStore') local function trim(s) return mw.text.trim(tostring(s or '')) end local function esc(s) return mw.text.encode(tostring(s or ''), '<>&"\'%[%]{}|') end -- Where the box sits on the page (float parameter), inline style local STYLES = { right = 'float:right; clear:right; margin:0 0 0.5em 1em;', left = 'float:left; clear:left; margin:0 1em 0.5em 0;', center = 'width:fit-content; max-width:100%; margin:0.5em auto;', } local function num(n) n = tonumber(n) if not n then return '' end if n == math.floor(n) then return string.format('%d', n) end return tostring(n) end -- Icon with border, name in the grade colour, amount (what Template:Item shows) local function itemHtml(frame, name, grade, amount, icon, over) grade = trim(grade) if grade == '' or grade == 'None' or grade == 'Any' then grade = 'Basic' end local out = IconName.icon({ args = { name, grade, file = icon or '', over = over or '' } }) .. ' ' .. frame:expandTemplate{ title = 'Grade', args = { grade, esc(name) } } if amount and amount ~= '' then out = out .. ' × ' .. esc(amount) end return out end local function coins(frame, copper) return frame:expandTemplate{ title = 'Coins', args = { num(copper) } } end function p.box(frame) local a = frame.args local r = Store.get('Recipes', a.id) if not r or not r.product then return '' end local float = trim(a.float):lower() local style = STYLES[float] or 'margin:0.5em 0;' local root = mw.html.create('div'):addClass('aa-recipebox') if float == 'right' or float == 'left' then root:addClass('aa-recipebox-float') end root:attr('style', style) local tbl = root:tag('table'):addClass('wikitable') local function row(label, content) local tr = tbl:tag('tr') tr:tag('th'):wikitext(label) tr:tag('td'):wikitext(content) end row('Recipe', itemHtml(frame, r.product.name, r.product.grade, num(r.product.amount), r.product.icon, r.product.over)) if r.labor then row('Labor Cost', '× ' .. num(r.labor)) end if r.station then row('Workbench', esc(r.station)) end if r.prof then local text = esc(r.prof) local req = tonumber(r.req) if req and req ~= 0 then text = text .. ' ' .. mw.language.getContentLanguage():formatNum(req) end row('Proficiency', text) end -- "Chance for 2x": the data says 100 + the extra percent; 10000 and the like are another scale local rate = tonumber(r.rate) if rate and rate > 100 and rate < 1000 then row('Chance for 2x', num(math.floor((rate - 100) * 10 + 0.5) / 10) .. '%') end local mats = {} for _, m in ipairs(r.materials or {}) do local grade = trim(m.required) if grade == '' or grade == 'Any' then grade = m.grade or '' end mats[#mats + 1] = '
' .. itemHtml(frame, m.name, grade, num(m.amount), m.icon, m.over) .. '
' end local coin = tonumber(r.coin) if coin and coin > 0 then mats[#mats + 1] = '
' .. coins(frame, coin) .. '
' end row('Materials', table.concat(mats)) -- live from the market; a failed request leaves an error text, then there is no row local cost = trim(a.cost) if not cost:find('class="error"', 1, true) then cost = tonumber(cost) if cost and cost > 0 then row('Recipe Cost', coins(frame, cost)) end end return tostring(root) end return p

Shows the in-game style tooltip card of any item. The template finds out what kind of item it is from the item ID and uses the right card: Template:Mount for mounts, Template:Glider for gliders and Magithopters, and Template:Consumable for everything else (potions, food, talismans, tokens, crates ...). Usage {{Tooltip|9002466}} The only required parameter is the item ID. The kind of item is read from the data stored by sync_wiki_data.py (Module:Data/Cards/...). An ID that is not stored yet is looked up live (one request to the API) until the script has been run. float (optional): right, left or center, passed on to the card. speed (optional): only used by mounts, replaces the speed from the API. use (optional): replaces the "Use:" text of the card (gliders and consumables). A new card type is added in Module:Tooltip: one line in the table REGISTRY (category of the item → template). Needs Module:Tooltip, Module:DataStore and the card templates. Examples {{Tooltip|9002466}} {{Tooltip|8001101|float=right}} {{Tooltip|36793}} No description. Template parameters Parameter Description Type Status Item ID 1 The item ID, for example 9002466 Number required Position float Optional. Where the card sits on the page: right or left (text flows around it) or center. Leave empty for a normal card in the flow of the page. Suggested values right left center String optional Speed (mounts) speed Optional. Only for mounts: replaces the speed from the API. String optional Use text use Optional. Replaces the "Use:" text of the card (gliders and consumables). String optional

local p = {} -- Picks the card template for an item ID. Used by Template:Tooltip. local Store = require('Module:DataStore') -- NEW CARD TYPE = one line here: the category of the item (category_name in the API) -> the template that shows it. -- Every category that is not listed uses DEFAULT. local REGISTRY = { Mount = 'Mount', Glider = 'Glider', Pets = 'Pet', ['Powerstone Pet'] = 'Pet', ['Battle Pet'] = 'Pet', -- Potion = 'Consumable', (listed only as an example, DEFAULT already covers it) } local DEFAULT = 'Consumable' local function trim(s) return mw.text.trim(tostring(s or '')) end -- The category of an item, when the sync script has stored it (nil when not) local function stored(id) local c = Store.get('Cards', id) if c and trim(c.category) ~= '' then return trim(c.category) end if Store.get('Mounts', id) then return 'Mount' end if Store.get('Gliders', id) then return 'Glider' end if Store.get('Pets', id) then return 'Pets' end return nil end -- {{#invoke:Tooltip|stored|ID}} -> "1" when the category is known from the stored data, otherwise nothing function p.stored(frame) return stored(frame.args[1]) and '1' or '' end -- {{#invoke:Tooltip|template|id=ID|live=<category from the API>}} -> name of the card template function p.template(frame) local a = frame.args local cat = stored(a.id) if not cat then cat = trim(a.live) if cat:find('class="error"', 1, true) then cat = '' end end return REGISTRY[cat] or DEFAULT end return p

Normally you use Template:Tooltip, which picks the right card for any item ID. Usage {{Consumable|9002463}} The only required parameter is the item ID. The data is read from data pages stored on the wiki (Module:Data/Cards/..., made by sync_wiki_data.py). An item that is not stored yet is read live from the APIs until the script has been run for it. The card shows the category (Potion, Food, Token ...), the grade, the name, "Untradeable" for bound items, the description, the "Use:" effect and "Cannot Sell", with the colours of the game. float (optional): right or left places the card at that side with the text flowing around it, center centres it. use (optional): replaces the "Use:" text. untradeable (optional): no hides the "Untradeable" line (the pet card uses this when it falls back to this card). cannotsell (optional): no hides the "Cannot Sell" line (also used by the pet card's fallback). Needs Module:Consumable, Module:IconName, Module:DataStore, Template:Grade and Template:Consumable/styles.css. Examples {{Consumable|9002463}} {{Consumable|9002466|float=right}} No description. Template parameters Parameter Description Type Status Item ID 1 The item ID, for example 9002463 Number required Position float Optional. Where the card sits on the page: right or left (text flows around it) or center. Leave empty for a normal card in the flow of the page. Suggested values right left center String optional Use text use Optional. Replaces the "Use:" text of the card. String optional Show Untradeable untradeable Optional. Write no to hide the "Untradeable" line. Suggested values no String optional Show Cannot Sell cannotsell Optional. Write no to hide the "Cannot Sell" line. Suggested values no String optional

local p = {} -- In-game style card for items that are used up or opened: potions, food, talismans, tokens, crates and -- every other item that has no card of its own. The category label (Potion, Food ...) comes from the API. local IconName = require('Module:IconName') local Store = require('Module:DataStore') -- data stored on the wiki by sync_wiki_data.py local function trim(s) return mw.text.trim(tostring(s or '')) end local function esc(s) return mw.text.encode(tostring(s or ''), '<>&"'%[%]{}|') end -- Colours of the game's short codes: |nc;...|r is orange, |ni;...|r is yellow, |nd;...|r is light blue ("loot drop rate"). Others show without colour. local NCODE = { c = 'FF9C27', i = 'F5CB65', d = 'A3E3FD' } -- The game marks highlighted words as |cFFRRGGBB...|r; only those parts get a colour. -- A coloured part may run over several lines: every line gets its own span, so lines can be split afterwards. local function coloured(text, hook) text = tostring(text or '') -- hook(code, inner) may return ready HTML for a |nX;...|r part (the pet card puts hoverable skills there) local toks = {} text = text:gsub('|n(%a);(.-)|r', function(code, inner) if hook then local h = hook(code, inner) if h then toks[#toks + 1] = h return '\1' .. #toks .. '\2' end end if NCODE[code] then return '|cFF' .. NCODE[code] .. inner .. '|r' end return inner end) local out, pos = {}, 1 while true do local s, e, rgb, inner = text:find('|c%x%x(%x%x%x%x%x%x)(.-)|r', pos) if not s then break end out[#out + 1] = esc(text:sub(pos, s - 1)) local parts = {} for _, seg in ipairs(mw.text.split(inner, ' ', true)) do if mw.text.trim(seg) == '' then parts[#parts + 1] = seg else parts[#parts + 1] = '' .. esc(seg) .. '' end end out[#out + 1] = table.concat(parts, ' ') pos = e + 1 end out[#out + 1] = esc(text:sub(pos)) local html = table.concat(out) if #toks > 0 then html = html:gsub('\1(%d+)\2', function(i) return toks[tonumber(i)] end) end return html end -- Where the card sits on the page (float parameter), set inline so it works without the style page local FLOATS = { right = 'float:right; clear:right; margin:0 0 0.5em 1em;', left = 'float:left; clear:left; margin:0 1em 0.5em 0;', center = 'margin:0 auto 0.5em auto;', } -- Binding of the item (bind_type of the API). "normal" shows nothing. local BIND = { soulbound_pickup = 'Untradeable', soulbound_unpack = 'Untradeable', soulbound_equip = 'Binds when equipped', } -- "-@ITEM_NAME(38620)" in a description is the name of that item local function names(text) return (text:gsub('@ITEM_NAME%((%d+)%)', function(id) local it = Store.get('Items', id) or Store.get('Cards', id) return it and trim(it.name) ~= '' and trim(it.name) or ('Item ' .. id) end)) end -- Text with line breaks: every line its own row, a blank line leaves some space local function paragraphs(text, class, hook) text = trim(names(tostring(text or ''):gsub(' ', ''))) if text == '' then return nil end local box = mw.html.create('div'):addClass(class) local gap = false for _, line in ipairs(mw.text.split(coloured(text, hook), ' ', true)) do line = trim(line) if line == '' then gap = true else local row = box:tag('div'):wikitext(line) if gap then row:addClass('aa-item-gap') end gap = false end end return box end local function fetched(s) s = trim(s) if s:find('class="error"', 1, true) then return '' end return s end -- shared with Module:Skill p.paragraphs = paragraphs -- The card from ready data d = { name, grade, category, icon, over, desc, use, bind, req, nosell } -- opts: float, hook (see coloured), use (replaces the Use text), bind (true = show "Untradeable"), nosell (false = hide "Cannot Sell") function p.render(frame, d, opts) opts = opts or {} local name = trim(d.name) local grade = trim(d.grade) local hasGrade = not (grade == '' or grade == 'None' or grade == 'Any') if not hasGrade then grade = 'Basic' end -- no grade: Basic look, and no grade line local category = trim(d.category) local use = trim(opts.use) if use == '' then use = trim(d.use) end local bind = BIND[trim(d.bind)] local float = trim(opts.float):lower() if not FLOATS[float] then float = '' end local root = mw.html.create('div'):addClass('aa-item') if float == 'right' or float == 'left' then root:addClass('aa-item-float') end if float == 'right' then root:addClass('aa-item-right') end if float ~= '' then root:attr('style', FLOATS[float]) end -- header: icon, category, grade, name local head = root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-item-head') head:tag('div'):addClass('aa-item-icon'):wikitext(IconName.icon({ args = { name, grade, size = 48, file = d.icon, over = d.over } })) local title = head:tag('div'):addClass('aa-item-title') if category ~= '' then title:tag('div'):addClass('aa-item-cat'):wikitext(esc(category)) end if hasGrade then title:tag('div'):addClass('aa-item-grade'):wikitext( frame:expandTemplate{ title = 'Grade', args = { grade, esc(grade) } }) end title:tag('div'):addClass('aa-item-name'):wikitext( frame:expandTemplate{ title = 'Grade', args = { grade, esc(name) } }) root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-item-sep') -- "Untradeable" only where the card asks for it (opts.bind); the required level is not shown if bind and opts.bind then root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-item-line'):wikitext(esc(bind)) end local body = paragraphs(d.desc, 'aa-item-desc', opts.hook) if body then root:node(body) end local useBox = paragraphs(use, 'aa-item-green') if useBox then root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-item-label'):wikitext('Use:') root:node(useBox) end if d.nosell and opts.nosell ~= false then root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-item-nosell'):wikitext('Cannot Sell') end return tostring(root) end function p.card(frame) local a = frame.args local d = Store.get('Cards', a.id) local name = d and trim(d.name) or fetched(a.name) if name == '' then return '' end local data if d then data = d else -- live data: sellable comes as true/false (or 1/0), the refund is the price the shop pays local sell = fetched(a.csell):lower() data = { name = name, grade = fetched(a.grade), category = fetched(a.category), icon = fetched(a.icon), over = fetched(a.over), desc = fetched(a.desc), use = fetched(a.cuse), bind = fetched(a.bind), req = fetched(a.req), nosell = (sell == 'false' or sell == '0' or fetched(a.crefund) == '0') } end return p.render(frame, data, { float = a.float, use = a.use, bind = trim(a.untradeable):lower() ~= 'no', nosell = trim(a.cannotsell):lower() ~= 'no' }) end return p

/* Item card (potions, food, talismans, tokens, crates ...). Same look as the Mount and Glider cards. Position comes inline from Module:Consumable. */ .aa-item { display: flow-root; position: relative; box-sizing: border-box; width: 300px; max-width: 100%; padding: 10px 12px; background: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(24, 28, 38, 0.97), rgba(10, 12, 18, 0.97)); border: 1px solid #5a5040; border-radius: 3px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #000, 0 4px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6); margin: 0 0 0.5em 0; color: #e8e4d8; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.5; text-align: left; } .aa-item-head { display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 6px; } .aa-item-icon { line-height: 0; } .aa-item-title { display: flex; flex-direction: column; line-height: 1.3; } .aa-item-cat { color: #e8e4d8; } .aa-item-grade { font-size: 13px; } .aa-item-name { font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; } .aa-item-sep { height: 1px; margin: 6px 0; background: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, #6a5d48, transparent); } .aa-item-line { color: #e8e4d8; } .aa-item-desc { margin-top: 4px; color: #e8e4d8; } /* a blank line in the description */ .aa-item-gap { margin-top: 0.7em; } .aa-item-label { margin-top: 10px; color: #8a8478; } .aa-item-green { color: #9acd32; } /* Cannot Sell */ .aa-item-nosell { margin-top: 10px; color: #d9423a; } /* A card floated to the right opens skill boxes (pets) towards the left, so they stay on the screen */ .aa-item-right .aa-mskill-tip { left: auto; right: 0; } /* Phones: a floated card gets its own line instead of squeezing the text */ @media (max-width: 500px) { .aa-item-float { float: none !important; clear: both !important; margin: 0 0 0.5em 0 !important; } /* skill hover boxes (pets) become a panel at the bottom of the screen (tap a skill to open) */ .aa-item .aa-mskill-tip { position: fixed; left: 0.5em; right: 0.5em; top: auto; bottom: 0.5em; width: auto; max-height: 60vh; overflow-y: auto; margin-top: 0; } }

local p = {} -- Card for pets (Pets, Powerstone Pet, Battle Pet): the Consumable look, with the skills in the description -- as hoverable names (the same hover box as the mount and glider skills). Data: Module:Data/Pets/..., made by -- sync_wiki_data.py; the skills' details come from Module:Data/Skills/... local Consumable = require('Module:Consumable') local Store = require('Module:DataStore') local Mount = require('Module:Mount') -- its hover box for a skill local function trim(s) return mw.text.trim(tostring(s or '')) end -- "Relaxed Life" and "relaxed life!" are the same skill local function key(s) return (tostring(s or ''):lower():gsub('[^%a%d]', '')) end -- {{#invoke:Pet|card|id=56039|float=|use=}} (nothing when the pet is not stored) function p.card(frame) local a = frame.args local d = Store.get('Pets', a.id) if not d or trim(d.name) == '' then return '' end local byName = {} for _, s in ipairs(d.skills or {}) do if s.name then byName[key(s.name)] = s end end -- the game writes the skill names as |nd;Name|r (light blue): those become hover boxes local function hook(code, inner) if code ~= 'd' then return nil end local s = byName[key(inner)] if not s then return nil end local sk = Store.get('Skills', s.id) or {} local html = Mount.hover({ args = { name = trim(inner), realname = sk.name or s.name or '', color = 'A3E3FD', cd = sk.cd or '', cast = sk.cast or '', mana = sk.mana and tostring(sk.mana) or '', desc = (sk.desc or s.desc or ''):gsub('\r', ''), icon = sk.icon or s.icon or '', } }) return (html:gsub('\n', ' ')) end return Consumable.render(frame, d, { float = a.float, use = a.use, hook = hook, nosell = false }) end return p

Shows an in-game style tooltip card for a skill: icon, skill line, name, element (top right), rank, mana, range, effect range, attack percent, cast time, cooldown, the effects it grants (buff icons), the description with the damage formula, combos and the chain the skill belongs to. This is a card you place on a page. The hover boxes of mount, glider and pet skills are separate and are not changed by this template. Usage {{Skill|36597}} The only required parameter is the skill ID (the number at the end of https://aa-classic.com/database/skills/36597). Skill IDs are not item IDs. The data is read from data pages stored on the wiki (Module:Data/SkillCards/..., made by sync_wiki_data.py). A skill that is not stored yet is read live from the API (without the effect icons) until the script has been run for it. Mana, range, effect range, cast time, cooldown, channeling time and labor cost are only shown when the data has them. The mana cost of many skills is calculated by the game and is 0 in the data, so no Mana line is shown then. Element (top right) and rank (after the name, Triple Slash (Rank 1)) come from the ancestral skill data. A skill that has ancestral variants shows Basic. Damage: the game's #{avg_damage} in the description is replaced by the formula of the data in green, for example (260% Melee Attack), and the line Melee Attack +260% is shown under the ranges. The final damage is not calculated, because it depends on gear, level and conditions in the game. Combo: the sentences of the game with the icon of the condition and the result. Chain: skills that follow each other (Triple Slash) show all steps with the icons, the skill of the card is outlined. Clicking another icon switches the card to that skill, there is no need to put each skill on the page. The chain is found automatically from the data, and all skills of a chain are stored by sync_wiki_data.py when one of them is. The switching uses a link to the card (the address gets #aa-skill1-36405 added) and CSS, so it also works for readers without scripts. All of this needs the skill to be stored (sync_wiki_data.py). A skill that is not stored yet is shown from the live API with the basic lines only. float (optional): right or left places the card at that side with the text flowing around it, center centres it. The icons need to be uploaded: upload_icons_by_api.py --kind skills and --kind buffs (effect and combo icons).
